newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates sink at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates sink at mid-session.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates sank slightly at mid-session on Tuesday as liquidity in the banking system remained loose despite recent mop-up measures by the central bank, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 6.454 percent against Monday's 6.558 close -- still far outside the central bank's 5.00-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper at 6.45-6.50 against 6.50-6.60.
The central bank on Monday issued T$3 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit.
But dealers said funds remained loose in the banking system as some T$18 billion worth of NCDs were due to mature this week.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 government bond yield was at 6.0785-6.0800 against 6.0765-6.0770.
